name: kal-ukfinder
//workspaces: `server` is a workspace so a root install also installs the API's dependencies — the serverless functions in api/ import from it and Vercel installs from this file. The apps are deliberately left out: Expo and Vite each expect their own node_modules.
description: Kal-UKFinder — UK jobs, careers news, government policy briefings and an AI career coach, on mobile and web.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix apps/mobile install && npm --prefix apps/admin install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/mobile run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/admin run typecheck
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix apps/mobile run build:web && node scripts/prepare-web.mjs
